leadText: The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the fourth season of , Johto League Champions, in and ( ).
plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the fourth season of , Johto League Champions, in and ( ).

==Single releases==
===DVD===
Johto League Champions was first released in single-disc DVD sets released between 2002-2004 by Viz Video and distributed by (now known as ) and Ventura Distribution, containing all 52 episodes across them all. Each volume has one disc with seven episodes, except the seventh volume which has ten episodes on one disc. Optional English closed captioning is included on the DVDs.

 

===VHS===
"High Voltage Collection" Johto League Champions single VHS releases were released in 2002-2004 by Viz Video and distributed by (now known as ) and Ventura Distribution. Each volume contains three select episodes from various points in the season, rather than sequential episodes. Altogether, 27 of the season's 52 episodes were released across the nine volumes.

The volume numbers of these VHS releases are a continuation of The Johto Journeys VHS and DVD volumes (skipping Volume 52, which was presumably reserved for the last two episodes of The Johto Journeys, which were never released on individual volumes).

Two episodes are mistitled on the back of the VHS covers: A Ghost of a Chance is listed as The Tower Inferno, and The Grass Route is listed as The Grass Root.

 

==The Complete Collection==
 
Pokémon - Johto League Champions: The Complete Collection was released on May 31, 2016 by VIZ Media and distributed through . This Complete Collection contains six discs with 52 episodes across them combined (although the cover incorrectly states that there are five discs). Its catalogue number is 3000067603. This release consists of a single DVD case in a slip cover. Optional English closed captioning is included on the DVDs.

 

==External links==
